types.text: Instructions: Children understand many more words than they say. We are particularly interested in the words your child SAYS. Please look at this list and indicate whether you have heard your child use each of these words spontaneously. If your child uses a different pronunciation of a word (e.g., "sketti" for "spaghetti"), please go ahead and indicate YES for that word. Remember that this is a list of words that are used by many different children - don't worry if your child uses only a few of these words right now. At the end of this list, you'll get an opportunity to tell us other English words your child says.
